prompt: Review an unseen relational workload and design its PostgreSQL reliability envelope. After the first review, adapt the design when one major constraint changes. Use only sanitized, reviewer-owned offline artifacts and no live database.
deliverables: Operation state transition invariant idempotency SLI SLO RPO and RTO contract.
Normalized data model with types keys constraints ownership retention and migration boundaries.
Transaction isolation lock order timeout cancellation retry and ambiguous-commit design.
Three representative query shapes with parameter distributions and safe plan-evidence method.
Index design with read write storage cache WAL build and rollback trade-offs.
Global connection pool concurrency timeout burst and failure-capacity budget.
Expand-and-contract migration and bounded resumable backfill plan.
Primary standby replication lag fencing client failover and failback design.
Backup archive recovery-point isolated restore and business validation plan.
Security observability cost incident runbook and changed-constraint decision.
evidenceRequirements: Reviewer supplies an unfamiliar workload packet and later changes traffic write ratio recovery objective region data residency team size or budget.
No production credential endpoint customer data live SQL cloud console provider change or external resource is allowed.
Every diagram labels state owner trust boundary failure scope and operating owner.
The learner distinguishes pool wait from SQL time and estimated plans from safely measured execution.
Isolation and retry are justified from named anomalies and operation idempotency.
Connection math includes maximum application replicas operator reserve and failure headroom.
Availability includes lag fencing authoritative timeline client recycling and ambiguous writes.
Recovery includes isolated restore measured phases achieved RPO/RTO and business invariants.
Reviewer observes changed-constraint reasoning delayed recall safety and cleanup.
